This Unlimited delivers the Wrangler heritage you expect with commanding capability and modern conveniences. Visit our showroom today to experience this distinctive 4WD SUV firsthand and discover why the Wrangler remains the choice for those who demand true versatility.

CARFAX Available: No Accidents! Enjoy a simple, transparent buying experience with upfront pricing, one dedicated point of contact, a 7-Day Money-Back Guarantee, and Low Price Protection—giving you complete confidence in your purchase. Safety and Security
  • Active blind spot system - Protect your blind side. You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Sporty looks, three rows and towing gear make this 2021 Ford Explorer XLT 4WD a well-rounded family SUV, and it shows 87,551 miles at Lincoln of Bloomington in Bloomington MN.

Carfax gives it a clean-title badge, and the Carbonized Gray Metallic paint looks sharp with the darker wheel package. Its original window sticker reveals an XLT ordered with nearly every popular upgrade:
- XLT Sport Appearance Package, with 20-inch Carbonized Gray 10-spoke wheels on P255/55R20 all-season tires
- Equipment Group 202A, adding remote start and an 8-way power passenger seat
- Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist+, which brings adaptive cruise, voice-activated touchscreen navigation and Evasive Steering Assist
- A twin-panel moonroof, a heated steering wheel and the Class III Trailer Tow Package

That is the combination most Explorer shoppers hunt for: XLT comfort, four-wheel drive, an open-sky roof and the hardware to tow. A 2.3L EcoBoost four-cylinder teams with a 10-speed automatic that includes paddle shifters, and the 4WD system is equally happy on a slushy commute or pulling a pontoon to the cabin.

Seating is flexible, with Light Slate ActiveX captain's chairs in the second row and a bench in the third. The front seats are heated and power-adjustable, three-zone automatic climate control keeps every row comfortable, and the leather-wrapped wheel tilts and telescopes. SYNC 3 supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.

Driver aids include blind spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, lane keeping, Pre-Collision Assist with automatic emergency braking, automatic high beams and a reverse camera with sensors. LED fog lamps, roof rails and a power liftgate complete the list.

Before listing, our technicians did a full used-vehicle inspection and an oil and filter change with a multi-point inspection, put in new engine and cabin air filters and front and rear wipers, and installed a Brake Plus rear-end collision deterrent light.

Who is this Explorer for? A family that wants three-row space, 4WD and towing capability with a sporty edge. It is a quick trip from Burnsville or Savage.

Buyer to confirm equipment and condition. Vehicle located at Lincoln of Bloomington, Bloomington MN 55420.

Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. The 2021 Ford Bronco Sport Big Bend immediately stands out for its technology-focused interior, offering a SYNC 3 infotainment system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration so drivers can seamlessly connect smartphones for music, navigation, and hands-free calls.

Tech-forward buyers who prioritize staying connected will appreciate how this SUV brings digital convenience to daily life. The SYNC 3 system offers voice-controlled access to apps, making it easy to send messages, get directions, or control music without fumbling with a device. For commuters in Lakeland, FL and beyond, features like remote keyless entry, automatic climate control, and a comprehensive trip computer cater to both comfort and modern efficiency. The Bronco Sport Big Bend lets drivers stay in touch with their digital world, whether running errands, tackling a commute, or heading out for a weekend adventure.

Driving the Bronco Sport Big Bend is enhanced by technology at every turn. Its 1.5L EcoBoost engine paired with an automatic transmission and 4WD provides confident performance, while electronic stability control and speed-sensitive steering offer a responsive, composed ride. Four-wheel independent suspension helps smooth out rough roads, and selectable drive modes—though not explicitly listed—are typically part of the Bronco Sport’s tech suite, adapting throttle and traction control for varied conditions. This digital approach to performance ensures efficient power delivery and driver confidence no matter the journey.

Smart safety defines the Bronco Sport’s approach, relying heavily on electronic systems to monitor surroundings and assist the driver. The SUV features a rearview camera that aids in parking by displaying real-time video, while auto high-beam headlights adjust brightness for changing light conditions. ABS brakes, electronic stability control, and traction control systems work in tandem to detect loss of grip and intervene instantly. SYNC 3’s 911 Assist provides emergency communication, leveraging connected technology to contact help if needed, underscoring a safety strategy built on intelligent sensors and real-time data processing.

The Bronco Sport Big Bend’s Equipment Group 200A brings a suite of convenience and tech features to daily drives. Automatic temperature control maintains cabin comfort, while heated power mirrors and speed-sensitive wipers add all-weather usability. The unique cloth front bucket seats provide both style and support, and the AM/FM stereo with SiriusXM enhances entertainment options. Smartphone integration via SYNC 3 means the driver’s favorite apps and contacts are always within reach, and the rearview camera makes reversing and parking easier and safer. These features collectively create a connected, comfortable environment for every passenger.

When compared to other compact SUVs like the Toyota RAV4 and Jeep Compass, the Bronco Sport Big Bend stands out for its advanced infotainment interface and seamless phone integration.

Does this SUV offer wireless CarPlay or Android Auto? While the Bronco Sport Big Bend includes wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto through SYNC 3, it does not specify wireless integration. What driver assistance tech is included? Standard features include a rearview camera, auto high-beam headlights, electronic stability control, and emergency communication via SYNC 3 911 Assist.

To experience the full suite of technology and connectivity features in the 2021 Ford Bronco Sport Big Bend, contact Lakeland Automall at (863) 577-5030 or visit 1430 W Memorial Blvd, Lakeland, FL 33815. Discover how staying connected on the road can be effortless and enjoyable in this smart, versatile SUV.

This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. Fast Out Of State Shipping Available..What the reviews say. The 2021 Atlas is a roomy and comfortable three-row SUV. An easy-to-use infotainment system and helpful driver aids are also part of the appeal. The Volkswagen Atlas was VW's first swing at a three-row midsize SUV, and the automaker knocked it out of the park. Its roomy cabin and comfortable ride helped place it near the top of the pack when it debuted in 2018. How's the interior? There's plenty of room in all directions up front, and the second row is wide enough for three adults across. Also the third row fits adults 6 feet or shorter with surprisingly little effect on comfort. The Atlas also gets high marks for its clever sliding second-row seat, with good rear visibility to boot. How's the tech? The Atlas boasts a strong assortment of technology features. The infotainment system includes Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone capability. The base stereo has pretty good quality, and the optional 12-speaker system on top models boasts impressive sound quality. A number of driver aids also come standard, and adaptive cruise control handles transitions and maintains gaps well for such a large vehicle. We also like the subtle lane keeping assist. The rearview camera is crisp and provides several viewing options. How's the storage? The Atlas dominates the midsize SUV competition with 20.6 cubic feet of space behind the third row and a maximum capacity of 96.8 cubic feet. The flexibility of the manual-folding flat seats is great, and our test SUV also had a hands-free tailgate. The 2021 Volkswagen Atlas has the boxy appearance, cavernous interior, and vast practicality that have defined SUVs for decades. It's also one of the biggest mid-size crossovers, with a giant footprint that gives way to three spacious rows of seating. The Atlas comes with one of two engines, a 235-hp four-cylinder or a 276-hp V-6. Both pair with an eight-speed automatic transmission and either front- or all-wheel drive. The V-6 feels and sounds refined, transmitting nary a shiver into the cabin. Family-friendly interior space, a straightforward control layout, and an overabundance of cupholders make the Atlas a practical choice, even among other highly practical rivals. Plus, a third row of seats that can comfortably accommodate full-size adults is a definite win. The cabin should accommodate just about anything a suburban family can throw at it, and there are plenty of thoughtfully placed storage nooks to stash small items.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
